limitations: Small synthetic, author-visible split; no independent blinded holdout or production-accuracy claim. Wilson intervals describe corpus sampling only.

Fixed English cues and selected Italian invoice/meeting forms; unsupported vocabulary/routines and incomplete or oversized screen context abstain. Holdout still misses onboarding, renewals and a meeting paraphrase.

Text does not prove that the user performed a job, that an output belongs to a particular real record, or that a workflow can safely execute. Unmarked research and replayed changing sequences can resemble activity.
Missing sidecar identities share the legacy unknown bucket; cross-device provenance cannot be certified there. Raw captures may already have expired when evidence is inspected.
New kinds require Q-13 constraint mapping at integration. Existing prepared branches have not been compiled or enabled together with this PR.
rollback: Disable awareness for containment. Roll back breadth by removing the three added ROUTINES entries while retaining v2 privacy, phase and recurrence guards. Preserve the additive column, hypotheses, dismissals and user work; never replay effects or drop data. See docs/opportunity-routines.md.
